steps.content: They escort you to an upscale private club with an open-air section that offers a panoramic view of the entire city. You recall seeing it from photographs; it's quite a renowned establishment.
On the way up, you notice that over a dozen floors below have been entirely cleared out. Evidently enough, they have meticulously prepared for this.

steps.speaker: Negotiator A
steps.content: Welcome to the most exquisite vista in all of DisCity. It is only fitting that a venue of such distinction plays host to your presence.

steps.speaker: Negotiator A
steps.content: Take it easy, Chief. Have a shot, maybe?
You leave the offered glass untouched.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: MBCC is a department with limited authority, but this? You're directly challenging the city's security laws and undermining the authority of both the FAC and the 9th Agency.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You've got some nerve. Who are you?

steps.speaker: Negotiator A
steps.content: We're just some nobodies who follow orders. Rest assured, we would never dare to cause you any harm.

steps.speaker: Negotiator A
steps.content: Should we cause you any distress, or should any esteemed individuals raise concerns in the future, we stand ready to extend our most heartfelt apologies and provide recompense until your contentment is restored.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So you're saying, no matter what you do to me now, you have ways to smooth things over afterward, is that it?
The man responds with a noncommittal smile.

steps.speaker: Negotiator A
steps.content: It won't be unpleasant, hopefully. We just want to have a little chat.
He turns on the TV.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: ...Not only did I cross paths with Chief ${PlayerName}, but I also connected with a vital witness.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Her existence links together all the Election Surprises, exposing the true darkness that touches every corner of our city. So, I must also conceal her identity until the investigation is complete—for her good of course.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: However, citizens, worry not—this witness will soon be relocated to the 9th Agency, where she will be granted the highest level of protection while her valuable insights can be put to optimal use.
Following a prolonged silence, you are the first to speak up.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I have nothing to do with that man.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This isn't the first time he used me for vote rigging. If you're sent by Cavendish, then this whole thing is pointless.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I have no interest in interfering with the election. I've never aligned with any side, nor will I in the future. Let us go.

steps.speaker: Negotiator A
steps.content: Ms. Cavendish would certainly appreciate your stance, but that's none of our concern.
Several figures in black swiftly put Jelena and Elvira under control.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: El!

steps.speaker: Negotiator A
steps.content: Hey—Easy now, Chief. Using your power here would be dangerous—we can't guarantee who these facilities might target, you know.

steps.speaker: Negotiator A
steps.content: Please put away that secret weapon of yours.
You slowly withdraw the shackles.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That was just instinct. Do not push me—I'm sure you wouldn't want to see me lose control... Let go of them. Now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do you want them muted, or do you want them to talk? Afraid they'll leak information that could be used against you?

steps.speaker: Negotiator A
steps.content: That is not what we are thinking of, but for others it might be.

steps.speaker: Negotiator A
steps.content: Normally, no one cares about such gossip matters. But you know, during election season, everyone's a bit sensitive. We'd rather not give anyone ammunition for baseless speculation.

steps.speaker: Negotiator A
steps.content: Now that everyone knows you have these ladies, and that you plan to hand them over to the 9th Agency... Just imagine what Stewart's enemies might do with that.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What exactly do you want?

steps.speaker: Negotiator A
steps.content: We want to protect you... in an appropriate manner.
Not protecting, but manipulating; not seeking your support, but treating you as a tool, a puppet.
They gaze down at you with feigned humility. Behind their masks, you see countless unseen eyes, forever self-righteous.
Who are they? Human or beast? How can you discern their true colors?
Perhaps it's the influence of the anti-Mania field—you feel dizzy when suddenly, a voice cuts through, interrupting your thoughts.
Are you going to betray us?

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: We gave you everything we could, ${PlayerName}. You promised to protect us—that was our deal.
Jelena's voice pulls you back to reality. Gradually, you gather your thoughts, your mind starting to clear.
You turn to face those men in suits.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let's be honest. I know that Stewart had leverage over you as well. If I were you, I wouldn't let them fall into other's hands, either.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I guess you won't harm them or coerce them into anything—that could backfire. By keeping them under watch, they might prove useful down the line, becoming leverage in future negotiations.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But, I won't simply hand them over to you. I made a deal with them, so I have to ensure their safety.

steps.speaker: Negotiator A
steps.content: ...A deal? You're willing to risk so much just because of a deal?

steps.speaker: Negotiator A
steps.content: Chief, in our business, the noble-minded never survive.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They've provided crucial leads about the cabinet attack. That's why I'm willing to risk getting involved.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Likewise with Max King—he has promised them refuge once he stands atop. That's why I've stomached working with a politician, helping him gain some momentum.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I may not know about surviving in politics, but after everything I've been through, I've long given up on being "noble." Now, deals are the only thing I know.
The negotiator's face lights up with a contented smile.

steps.speaker: Negotiator A
steps.content: Hahahaha... I should have picked up your approach more quickly.

steps.speaker: Negotiator A
steps.content: Name your terms, please. What would it take to make you satisfied?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: First and foremost, ensure their safety, and no more handing them off to anyone else. That's the price for my guilty conscience.
Jelena freezes in astonishment. When she attempts to step forth, the surrounding guards obstruct her path.

steps.speaker: Negotiator A
steps.content: Haha, now I see what you meant by "leverage." You're right—they are valuable indeed.

steps.speaker: Negotiator A
steps.content: You said you don't like politics, yet I dare say, Chief, you are exceptionally well-equipped for this circle.
Jelena trembles as she holds Elvira tightly in her arms, yet no one present seems to take notice of them anymore. The rooftop scene carries on in perfect harmony.

He waves his hand, prompting another man with a perfectly rehearsed smile to stride forward. The man swiftly lays out a set of presentation materials before you, complete with elaborate text and illustrations.

steps.speaker: Negotiator B
steps.content: You have no interest in money, surely, but we know you care for the West District. Nirvana has been stifling the new mine there, even pressuring Stewart to strip out Syndicans with a decree.

steps.speaker: Negotiator B
steps.content: While the actions cannot be changed, we can push for favorable policies moving forward. This could include industrial licenses, employment, social security benefits, and even pathways to citizenship.

steps.speaker: Negotiator B
steps.content: Ah yes, we can guarantee they get their voter eligibility one year early, that is to say, they'll have the right to participate in the NEXT election.

steps.speaker: Negotiator B
steps.content: Also, we've also got some dirt on Nirvana. We can make it a bit trouble for them, if you want.
...So they're not with Nirvana, you think.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: David Stewart is dead. The remaining candidates are both supportive of the West District—your intervention isn't needed. Sooner or later, Syndicans will find their own way forward.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Besides, I'm not a spokesperson for the West District. I'm just doing my job; my goals lie elsewhere.
The man's smile grows more genuine.

steps.speaker: Negotiator B
steps.content: Absolutely, I understand. Your ambitions surely reach far beyond something as small as the West District.

steps.speaker: Negotiator B
steps.content: We understand the weight of your responsibilities, and you certainly deserve a higher position, free from anyone else's thumb. Take... the FAC, for instance! You shouldn't have to answer to them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are you saying that you can handle the FAC?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Heh, don't take me for a fool. If you had that kind of power, you wouldn't need to come to me with such a roundabout talk.
The negotiators flash sly smiles.

steps.speaker: Negotiator B
steps.content: Even the most robust walls have their vulnerabilities. We once had a close relationship with the FAC, so we are well aware of their weak spots. If backstabbing's what you want, we can make you a myriad of knives for that.

steps.speaker: Negotiator B
steps.content: Or perhaps there are other enemies you'd like us to... take care of?
During your brief silence, another person joins the conversation.

steps.speaker: Negotiator C
steps.content: Read the room, would ya? Our Chief isn't even remotely interested—your propositions are far from appealing.

steps.speaker: Negotiator C
steps.content: Chief, I know what you are capable of, and I'm aware that Paradeisos is backing you. With all of that, anything we bring to the table, you'd secure on your own in due time.

steps.speaker: Negotiator C
steps.content: Let's talk about something DisCity can't offer you, Chief... Ever heard the saying about not having all your eggs in one basket?

steps.speaker: Negotiator C
steps.content: Investment in the Outlands—if you're interested, we could set you up with a whole little city of your own there. Just as a backup plan, you know, in case anything goes awry in DisCity.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: ...That would be high treason against DisCity.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The 9th Agency would have my head for this. Is that what you're after, something to level against me down the line?!
Your response seems to please him. Sensing that he has gained the upper hand, he reclines in his seat with fingers interlaced.

steps.speaker: Negotiator C
steps.content: Well, of course we all hope that the great DisCity continues to prosper for another century.

steps.speaker: Negotiator C
steps.content: But if we look at the bigger picture, Chief, even the common folk can see times are changing. The economy, governance, military power—everything's changing. Where there's risk, there's opportunity.

steps.speaker: Negotiator C
steps.content: Many of the elites are already hedging their bets, moving assets to the Outlands. With DisCity's strong presence abroad, setting this up wouldn't be too hard now.

steps.speaker: Negotiator C
steps.content: But for people like you, with your exceptional prowess, Paradeisos's watchful eye can be quite the hindrance. We know, and that's where we come in.

steps.speaker: Negotiator C
steps.content: And we can help kill two birds with one stone here—once we relocate the two ladies, they'll be out of harm's way.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Can you really pull this off?

steps.speaker: Negotiator C
steps.content: Absolutely. Our employers boast a century-long legacy of influence. Their reach extends far beyond what you can see. Chief, this partnership promises mutual gain. We extend a cordial invitation for you to join us.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...That's quite a generous offer. The last point has piqued my interest, in particular.

steps.speaker: Negotiator B
steps.content: That's right—whatever you want, we can make it happen.

steps.speaker: Negotiator A
steps.content: Our esteemed employers have built up considerable influence over time, Chief. It is with the utmost admiration that they regard you, and they would love to have you in our exclusive inner circle.

steps.speaker: Negotiator A
steps.content: And now, anything you want to know? Shall we make a deal?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Were you the ones who schemed the Underground attack?

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: Hahahahaha!

steps.speaker: Negotiator A
steps.content: My sincerest apologies. Your devotion to work is truly commendable, Chief. However, such moves are unnecessary in our case—I'm sorry, but we are not the culprits.

steps.speaker: Negotiator A
steps.content: Stewart was doing quite a decent job. We were, in fact, eager for him to continue his service for another term. Now with his death, regrettably, all our investments in him have gone to waste.

steps.speaker: Negotiator A
steps.content: Does this explanation sufficiently prove our innocence?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That’s valuable information—hard to come by. Maybe we should consider an intel exchange.
You observe a shift in their demeanor upon your mention of an exchange—there's now an underlying hint of impatience and doubt beneath their thin veneer of respect.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: During the West District crisis, the Department of Labor pushed the Outland Affairs Bureau to ease immigration policies, taking in "inferior populations" to fill service sector gaps. But as things escalated, stricter measures were hastily imposed, leaving numerous immigrants to die outside the city.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: About the FAC you just mentioned—under the instruction of certain leaders, they resorted to extreme measures several times to secure their budget, and consequently, the entire FAC had to face disciplinary action.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: In N.F. 103, the same group embezzled pension funds, leaving grieving families destitute. A few FAC members protested, only to be fired soon after. The incident caused quite a stir but was kept quiet until a resolution finally came about last year.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We don't even have to discuss the media, given that all news is monitored. Whenever there's a scandal or crisis, they'd just incite unrest in the West District or exaggerate Outland threats. But Mania? Completely off-limits—too risky to even mention.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Even now, the media continues to demonize the satellite towns and West District, all so their puppet masters can grab a bigger piece of the pie and manipulate the narrative.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And...

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: That's enough, Chief. You may drop the act now.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: They've proved your guess.
She calls out to you softly, her voice deep and gentle.
With each secret you reveal, the negotiators' expressions grow darker. The moment Jelena interrupts you, they exchange a glance and draw their guns without hesitation.

steps.speaker: Negotiator A
steps.content: It is truly regrettable, Chief. We did intend for collaboration. However, you have stumbled upon some things that you're not supposed to know.

steps.speaker: Negotiator C
steps.content: Get rid of them, all three. Dump the bodies at any of the Underground attack sites.
The bodyguard behind you steps forward, attempting to press a gun to your head. However, an invisible force knocks the weapon from his grasp just as ear-splitting alarms start blaring.
The silver wig atop the young girl's head suddenly flies off, unveiling her own steel-blue hair beneath.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Leave the rest to me.
As planned, the moment Nightmare charges into the crowd, Jelena's silver chains smoothly pull you behind her.

BOOM! The roar of a hand cannon echoes through the air as muzzle flashes burst from multiple weapons, unleashing a barrage of fire in this direction. It's your allies, firing from the building across the street.
In the midst of exuberant shouts, machine gun fire pursues the panicked men in suits, the bullets snapping at their heels like whips.

steps.speaker: Negotiator B
steps.content: Aaaahhh—! Heeelp!!

steps.speaker: Negotiator A
steps.content: W-who else is there?

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Chief!! Are you all good?!! We've rented out the building across the street to back you up!!

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Careful with your shots, Adrian! Don't hit Chief. I'll go get the chopper!
Max King's concern proves unwarranted as each machine gun maintains flawless accuracy. Only the negotiators, caught in the crossfire, stand frozen in place, their faces drained of color with fear.

steps.speaker: Vale
steps.content: Chief, the Bureau's reinforcements have arrived as well. You have our full support. Please handle the threat before Master King arrives.

steps.speaker: Vale
steps.content: Mr. King's always impulsive. Any harm befalling him could impact the election.

steps.speaker: Negotiator C
steps.content: How—how did they know our location?! We've checked all the comms... You have a tracker on you?!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No, your examination was quite thorough. I couldn't have brought a tracker in. But I do have something else up my sleeve.
As you speak, you unleash your shackles, letting the sirens continue their wail.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They know I have shackles, but they seem unaware of the sensing ability. This will narrow down our list of suspects quite a bit.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Thanks for your leads, Mr. Kidnappers. Now it's time to surrender. In return for your hospitality, let's have a nice, long chat back at the office.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The 9th Agency has been waiting for you eagerly.

steps.speaker: Negotiator C
steps.content: Th-they paid me to do this!! This has nothing to do with me!!
